data.one_liner: Combinatorics library for permutations, combinations, subsets, and related pseudo-lists.
data.what_it_does: Provides pseudo-list classes that generate combinations, permutations, compositions, amalgams, subsets, and compounds based on the Steinhaus-Johnson-Trotter algorithm and its generalizations.
use_when: You need to generate mathematical combinations or permutations in your app.
You are building puzzles, games, or algorithms requiring combinatorial arrangements.
avoid_when: You are dealing with extremely large arrangements where memory-efficient streams or lazy evaluation are preferred without overhead.
strengths: Simplifies complex combinatorics tasks with ready-to-use classes.
Efficiently indexes arrangements without iterating through all preceding elements.
weaknesses: Limited to combinatorics use cases and basic utilities.
